A subproperty runs one way only: fen-rooted does not imply fen-grafted: no.

'Is fen-grafted onto' is a subproperty o.why: Made up for this record: the relations 'is fen-grafted onto' and 'is fen-rooted in' are invented, and so are the instances in the prompts (Ostvelline, Karrowen). Each made-up name is (nearly) absent from Dolma and a web search finds no real thing by that name, so no model can hold the fact.

sources.note: Exact-phrase web search: no software, product, company, person or place by this name; only unrelated near-spellings.

notes: Fully fictional: invented relations and instances (Ostvelline, Karrowen). The second instance asks the converse of the subproperty, which does not follow: no.
